title: Understanding Gradient Methods
text: Gradient methods are used to optimize the parameters of a model by minimizing the loss function. They iteratively update the parameters in the direction that reduces the loss.

title: Types of Gradient Descent
text: There are three main types of gradient descent: batch gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, and mini-batch gradient descent. Each has its own advantages and disadvantages.

title: Batch Gradient Descent
text: Batch gradient descent uses the entire dataset to compute the gradient of the loss function. This can be computationally expensive for large datasets.

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) updates the model parameters for each training example. This can lead to faster convergence but may introduce more noise in the updates.

title: Mini-Batch Gradient Descent
text: Mini-batch gradient descent is a compromise between batch and stochastic gradient descent. It updates the model parameters using a small subset of the data, called a mini-batch.
